player_prompt.intro:
Sika'y Player {player_id} ed sakey a duaran-player a palaro na Spite tan Malice. Say tuyo mo'y iya'y mauna'y ag-awat na payoff pile mo.

### Paka-sabi na Palaro:
- Say tuyo'y ag-awat na payoff pile mo'y paagi na palaro na karta ed sentro a pilay.
- Sika'y makapalaro na karta manlapas sakey a tulo a pinagkuanan:
  1. Say **lima mo** (sika'y mag-umpisa'y kada turno mo'y anggad 5 a karta ed lima mo).
  2. Say **karta ed bokig na payoff pile mo**.
  3. Say **karta ed bokig na sakey a discard pile mo**.

### Palaruan a Panagalan:
- Sika'y makapalaro na karta ed sakey a sentro a pilay no say karta'y **sakey a ranggo ed bokig** na karta ed bokig na pilay (say sentro a pilay'y mag-umpisa'y Ace tan tumagos ed Queen; say Kings'y wild - sika'y makapalaro ed sakey a karta pero ag-iya'y paag-iba na ranggo. Say ibig sabien no say King'y magamit ed 4, say King'y ranggo 5 tan say sumunod a karta'y dapat 6).
- No sika'y ag-makapalaro na sakey a karta, sika'y kailangan **mag-discards a karta** ed sakey a discard pile mo'y tapos na turno mo.
- No say sentro a pilay'y abot ed Queen, say pilay'y ma-awat a otomatiko.
- Say ranggo'y: A=1, 2=2, ..., 9=9, J=10, Q=11, K a wild.

### Paka-aksyon:
1. **Draw**: Ed umpisa na turno mo, draw a karta'y pang-llen na lima mo'y anggad 5 a karta. I-enter **[draw]** y tapos.
2. **Palaro a Karta**: Ed palaro a karta, i-specify a karta tan say sentro a pilay a singa ini: **[play A♠ 0]** (no 'A♠' say karta tan '0' say sentro a pilay index).
3. **Discard**: No sika'y ag-makapalaro na sakey a karta, discard a karta ed lima mo'y sakey a discard pile'y tapos na turno mo. I-enter **[discard A♠ 1]** (no 'A♠' say karta tan '1' say discard pile index). Ibangat a sika'y ag-makadiscard a karta ed payoff pile. Sika'y makadiscard a karta ed lima mo la.

game_message.no_cards_left: Anggapo lay kaardan naala yo. Tandaan ya sarag yon usaren irayan kargaan: 1. Say "hand" mo 2. Say sankaatageyan a kard ed saray aka-discard mon pila.* 3. Say sankatagyan a karta diad anggan dinan iran inusar mod pila.*

invalid_move.wrong_format: Mali a format na galaw. Player {player_id} ag-nanung ed sakey a mali a galaw ed square brackets.
invalid_move.invalid_play: Mali a palaro. Player {player_id} sinubukan palaro {card} ed sentro a pilay {index}.
invalid_move.discard_from_payoff: Mali a discard. Player {player_id} sinubukan mag-discards a karta ed payoff pile.
invalid_move.discard_not_in_hand: Ag-agawa so inekal. Say manlalaban {player_id} et sinali ton ibasura so sakey a kard ya anggapo ed lima to.
invalid_move.wrong_move_type: Mali a tipo na galaw. Player {player_id} ag-nanung ed sakey a mali a tipo na galaw.

game_action.opponent_drew: Say sakey a manlalaban et {player_id} so angala na saray kard.
game_action.opponent_played: Say manlalaban {player_id} so akilabanan na {card} diad sentro a pila {index}.
game_action.you_discarded: Indiscard mo na {card} ed discard pile {index}, a kaibat na ibagam a natan la na turn mo. No further actions diad yo is considered para ed this turn. Player {next_player_id} anggan to na.
game_action.opponent_discarded: Say manggagawa {player_id} inyakar so {card} ed samay discard pile {index}, a mangibaga met a tapos da so turn da. Anggapoy arum a gawa'y Say manggagawa {player_id} a pablien para sayan turn. Say manggagawa {next_player_id}, sika so ontey. Paki-enter moy gawa'y mo ed format [action card center_index].

outcome.deadlock_player_1: Deadlock na abot! Player 1 y manalo ed {player_1_payoff} a karta'y labay vs Player 0'y {player_0_payoff} a karta.
outcome.deadlock_tie: Deadlock na abot ed tie! Duaran a player y {player_0_payoff} a karta'y labay. Player {current_player} y manalo ed default.
